title: Career Roadmap: Data Analyst
summary: Analyse data to identify patterns, explain social and business trends, measure performance and support evidence-based decisions. This pathway combines analytical skills with an understanding of how data and technology affect people, organizations and society.

facts.Current degree: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies (BA / B.Sc Liberal Arts & Sciences)

about.label: Education Pathway
about.text: Liberal Arts / Liberal Studies – Data, Society & Technology

blocks.text: Analyse data to identify patterns, explain social and business trends, measure performance and support evidence-based decisions. This pathway combines analytical skills with an understanding of how data and technology affect people, organizations and society.

rows.text: Any stream, subject to programme eligibility; Mathematics and Statistics are advantageous
Liberal Arts degree with a concentration in Data, Society & Technology, Data Analytics, Economics or Statistics
Business analytics, social research, public policy analytics, product analytics or data visualization
M.Sc. Data Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, Computational Social Science or a related field

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Since this is an interdisciplinary degree, select electives that provide sufficient training in statistics, databases, programming and quantitative research.

blocks.label: Data Analysis
blocks.text: Data cleaning, exploratory analysis and identifying trends.

blocks.label: Programming
blocks.text: SQL and Python with pandas and NumPy.

blocks.label: Statistics
blocks.text: Descriptive statistics, probability, correlation and hypothesis testing.

blocks.label: Visualization
blocks.text: Power BI, Tableau or Python visualization libraries.

blocks.label: Social & Business Context
blocks.text: Understand bias, data privacy, digital inclusion and the limits of quantitative evidence.

blocks.label: Communication
blocks.text: Translate findings into clear reports and actionable recommendations.
Build three or four projects that combine data analysis with real-world context:

blocks.label: Social Trends Dashboard
blocks.text: Analyse public datasets on education, employment or demographics.

blocks.label: Digital Society Study
blocks.text: Investigate technology access or digital adoption using publicly available data.

blocks.label: Business Analytics
blocks.text: Examine sales, customer behaviour or operational performance.

blocks.label: Public Policy Analysis
blocks.text: Explore a socioeconomic question using official datasets.

blocks.label: Data Ethics Review
blocks.text: Assess privacy, representation and potential bias in a sample analytical project.
For each project, document the research question, data source, cleaning process, analysis, limitations and conclusions.
Target placements at:

items.text: Social science and public policy research organizations.
Digital transformation and data strategy teams.

blocks.text: Search for Data Analyst Intern, Research Analyst Intern, Business Intelligence Intern, Product Analytics Intern and Social Data Research Intern roles.
Prioritize:

items.text: Data ethics, privacy and responsible AI fundamentals.

blocks.text: Use certifications to support practical work, not as a substitute for project experience.
Data / Research Intern
Junior Data Analyst
Data Analyst / Business Intelligence Analyst
Senior Analyst → Analytics Lead / Data Strategy Specialist
With additional research methods and statistical training, possible transitions include computational social science, policy analytics or data science.

items.text: E-commerce, retail and financial services companies

rows.text: Learn Excel, SQL fundamentals, statistics and data-cleaning methods.
Analyse a public dataset using Python and build an interactive dashboard.
Complete two portfolio projects, practise analytical interviews and apply for internships.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills, Python-based analysis, statistical reasoning, data visualization and the ability to interpret findings within social or business contexts.
